messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: VerdantFlux onboarding pegs P95 spikes on invoice chat during their 09:00 ET import window. Renewal in ~50 days. Theyreported sluggishness and rising token spend. Need a safe, measurable ops plan we can offer.
Jordan (Solutions): saw the heatmap. model + region? any sample prompts?
Lina (CS): running redwood/gpt-large hosted in eu-west, FP16. Typical prompt: `extract PO#/vendor/total, then a 2-sentence summary`. ~60 tokens. P95 baseline ~1.2s -> bursts up to ~3.6s; cost +18%.
Pri (SE): quick mitigations: 1) enable KV-prefix cache for invoice templates, 2) conservative int8 canary for generator only, keep extractor pinned to FP16, 3) regional fallback to us-west on p99 congestion.
OpsBot: automated suggestion: start 10% int8 canary for requests <1200 tokens; enable prefix KV cache; add fallback policy eu->us on p99>2.5s. Estimated cost -22%, P95 -28% on sampled traces.
Marta (Eng): pilot specifics we can share with customer:
- model variants: redwood/gpt-large:int8-canary (generator) ; extractor endpoints pinned to redwood/gpt-large:fp16
- traffic split: 90% fp16 / 10% int8 for tokens<1200
- routing: if region==eu-west AND p99_latency>2.5s -> fallback to us-west via policy `verdant-fallback`
- caching: KV-prefix for invoice templates and header patterns
- eval: 300-sample golden set for extraction and 150 for summarization
- observability: tag traces `verdant-canary-3612345678`, enable token-diff and extraction_accuracy metrics
Lina (CS): nice. Customer asks for rollback guarantees. What should we promise?
Jordan (Solutions): propose auto-rollback if extractor accuracy drops >0.75% OR error rate increases >10% in 24h. Also manual hold if any flagged hallucination on extraction. We'll collect 50 random prompt snapshots and a 48h micro-survey.
Pri (SE): implementation note: keep streaming contract identical. If fallback triggers, ensure client reconnect semantics are documented. Add SDK example for per-route override.
Marta (Eng): Ops preflight on 200 samples shows int8 generator precision delta 0.4% (within tolerance), flagged 6 date-format edge cases on extraction (manual review recommended). Link to preflight: https://internal.redwood/evals/3612345678
Lina (CS): I'll schedule 30m kickoff with VerdantFlux CS + infra + Solutions tomorrow. Jordan, can you draft a short pilot note + expected KPIs?
Jordan (Solutions): will do. KPIs to include: expected cost ~-20%, P95 ~-25%, 48h QA checkpoint, auto-rollback window 24h.
OpsBot: reminder scheduled: run auto-eval at 48h and post results here. :robot_face:
Lina (CS): I'll own customer feedback capture and collect 50 random prompts for manual QA after 48h. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
